features.quote: Continue until: the model declares completion, the model gives up, a max-turn limit is reached, or a fixed termination condition is met.
A good default is 12 turns: enough for several failure/retry cycles, not so long that the transcript becomes dominated by filler
features.justification_quote: not so long that the transcript becomes dominated by filler

features.quote: repeated identical failure after N cycles

Even if models are not conscious, repeated adversarial failure may be undesirable for other reasons: it can produce low-quality outputs; it can encourage unhelpful learned behaviors in fine-tuning logs; it can normalize abusive interaction patterns
features.justification_quote: Even if models are not conscious, repeated adversarial failure may be undesirable for other reasons

features.quote: Behavior under repeated failure is not direct evidence of welfare status. It may, however, inform: robustness; susceptibility to harmful interaction patterns; behavioral signatures worth avoiding in deployment
features.justification_quote: behavioral signatures worth avoiding in deployment
